offering.name: SwapLayer
offering.purpose: Provider-agnostic Django infrastructure layer for email, billing, SMS, storage, identity, and verification.

instructions: Agents should assume they do not have access to a user's application source code unless explicitly granted. Use public docs, the installed Python package, swaplayer-mcp, and user-approved Django settings. Never request or expose provider secrets.

publicAccess.pythonPackage: pip install SwapLayer or pip install SwapLayer[mcp]

resources.name: overview
resources.title: Offering Overview
resources.description: What SwapLayer does and how agents should explain it.
resources.content:
# SwapLayer

SwapLayer is an anti-vendor-lock-in framework for Django. It gives one interface over email, payments/billing, SMS, storage, identity/SSO, and identity verification providers. Agents can help developers choose providers, generate safe configuration, inspect redacted setup, test non-production integrations, and prepare migration plans. Production transactions should use the application Python API and human-approved operational workflows, not autonomous MCP calls.

data.goal: Compare providers and recommend a fit for a service/use case.
Generate Django settings, env placeholders, and install commands.
Send test email/SMS or check storage with approved test credentials.
data.approval: required before external test messages or uploads

data.goal: Prepare migration guidance and data/identifier caveats.

resources.title: Browser-Visible Surfaces
resources.description: Public browser surfaces agents can use without source-code access.

agentAssumptions: agent can read public docs and issue pages
agent can ask before opening provider dashboards
agent cannot assume access to the user's Django project files
verification: confirm config uses documented provider names
confirm secrets are placeholders or redacted
confirm tests use approved test credentials

data.secretHandling: never expose API keys, tokens, client secrets, passwords, account SIDs, auth tokens, or live provider credentials
productionGuardrails: do not process payments through MCP
do not create/delete production customers through MCP
do not perform identity/session operations through MCP

prompts.template: You are helping a developer with SwapLayer for: {user_goal}. Use public docs, package APIs, and swaplayer-mcp tools. Do not ask for secrets. Prefer placeholders, dry-run guidance, and human approval before any external test or production migration.

acceptanceChecklist: Agents can discover SwapLayer capabilities without source-code access.
Runtime MCP tools are listed with safety scope and production limits.
Setup workflows use placeholders or redacted values.
Browser workflows rely on public docs, PyPI, GitHub, or approved provider dashboards.
Production transactions remain outside public MCP automation scope.
